title: Russian embassy claims are nonsense, explains Latvia
summary_full: The Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Latvia issued a statement on November 26th that essentially said that the latest claims made by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Russia are 'disinformation', i.e. complete nonsense.
